data.description:
## Goal
Create plugins/dso/scripts/render-closure-narrative.sh that renders closure narrative from typed verifier fields using bash+jq only. No LLM call permitted in this script.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/render-closure-narrative.sh

## Requirements
- Reads verifier JSON from stdin or file argument
- Sources narrative text exclusively from: ticket_id, overall_verdict, P1 (when schema_version=2), criteria_results[].verdict, remediation_tasks_created[].title
- Template-driven output (bash variable interpolation + jq, no subprocess LLM)
- Idempotent: same inputs always produce same output

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/render-closure-narrative.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-render-closure-narrative.sh exits 0 (all cases GREEN)

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S2/T1)
data.title: T2: RED — Implement render-closure-narrative.sh (bash+jq only)
